## 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(openintro)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
#read in the healthy reference cohort csv
healthy_reference <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/xe_healthy_reference_cohort.csv")
```

```{r}
healthy_reference_filtered <- healthy_reference |>
  filter(`Include (1=Yes 0 =No)` == 1)
```

```{r}
#calculate vc/va ref and va ref
healthy_reference_vc <- healthy_reference_filtered |> mutate(
    vc_over_va_ref = 15.4 -
      0.972 * (sex == "M") -
      0.0391 * `Age (years)` -
      0.000352 * `Age (years)`^2,
    va_ref = if_else(
      sex == "M",
      -7.9 + 0.0387 * `Age (years)` + 0.0774 * height - 0.000442 * `Age (years)`^2,
      -3.55 + 0.0391 * `Age (years)` + 0.0466 * height - 0.000426 * `Age (years)`^2
    ))
```

```{r}
#summarize mean and sd for vc/va ref and va ref
healthy_reference_vc |> 
  summarise(
    vc_over_va_mean = mean(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    vc_over_va_sd   = sd(vc_over_va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_mean         = mean(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE),
    va_sd           = sd(va_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
